{C:81935F02}{C:81958296592F00000000}Well, aren't you impressive,

{C:81935E02}{C:819582965D2F00000000}I never had any intention of negotiating.

{C:8193A202}{C:819582965E2F00000000}What?!

{C:8190BD02}{C:81958296AA2F00000000}Master Asia, Undefeated of the East...
Whatever you call yourself,
what exactly are you trying to do?!

{C:8190BE02}{C:81958296AB2F00000000}Yeah, I'd like to know too.

{C:8190C602}{C:81958296AC2F00000000}Would you tell us, old man?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296AD2F00000000}You can't understand unless I explain...
That's why you're all idiots!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296B02F00000000}Master!
We're risking our lives in these battles!
Please explain it to them!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B12F00000000}Arago learned of a baby who crossed time and space
and is plotting to take
that power for himself.

{C:81958296B22F00000000}I learned of this before anyone else
and took action, but I couldn't
find out where Arago was.

{C:8190C702}{C:81958296B32F00000000}So you infiltrated the enemy's ranks.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B42F00000000}Precisely.
But I couldn't locate his castle without gaining his trust.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296B52F00000000}So you turned against us
and took Natsumi away from us?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296B62F00000000}I never imagined the Four Masho
would do what they did, though.
That was the one thing I miscalculated.

{C:8190C802}{C:81958296B72F00000000}Forget about that for now.
Let's hurry up and rescue Natsumi and the others!

{C:8190C102}{C:81958296B92F00000000}Oh, what a splendid idea!
I think you and I will get along, little monkey!
Come on, let's get moving!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296BA2F00000000}Hmm, you're right.
For now, I'll devote all my strength
to rescuing Natsumi and Mirai.

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296C53700000000}What is it, Shuten?

Lord Arago is acting strangely?

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296C73700000000}You think so too?

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296C83700000000}So you've all felt it as well?

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296C93700000000}It seems none of us

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296CA3700000000}I suspect that Lord Arago

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296CB3700000000}If that's true, what will you do?

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296CC3700000000}Surely you don't mean to defy him?

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296CD3700000000}If he truly is Lord Arago,

Shall we try fighting him?


{C:8190C001}{C:81958296CE3700000000}You seem to be wavering.
Understandably so.

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296CF3700000000}Master,
do you know something?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D13700000000}Your leader is an impostor.
Though I don't know where the real one is.

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296D23700000000}How do you expect us
to believe that?

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296D33700000000}You fool!
How dare you call yourselves the Four Masho
when you can't even see that?!

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296D43700000000}I'll side with Master Asia.

I cannot let that impostor go unpunished.

{C:8190B402}{C:81958296D53700000000}So we are to fight?

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296D63700000000}Master,
we would like you
to let us join your group as well.

{C:8190AD02}{C:81958296D83700000000}What?!

{C:8190B302}{C:81958296D93700000000}Then shall we settle this right here?!

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296DA3700000000}Kaaaah!
Stop it, you fools!

{C:81958296DB3700000000}This is not where we belong!
A true battle is fought where one belongs!
Do not fight meaningless battles!

{C:8190B102}{C:81958296DC3700000000}You are right.

{C:8190AA02}{C:81958296DD3700000000}Then let us fight together.

{C:8190B202}{C:81958296DE3700000000}Very well.
But if Lord Arago is not an impostor,
we will strike you down at once!

{C:8190AB02}{C:81958296DF3700000000}I'd like to see you try!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E03700000000}Well, let's move on.

{C:8190C001}{C:81958296E13700000000}Good. Let's head to the final battlefield!
